title: History baseline verdict, arm H (evaluator-only)
description: One file per cohort case, <out>/<case_id>.json, written by `miner history-baseline`: the zero-LLM baseline's verdict from pre-cutoff repository history alone. The top-level fields schema_version, case_id, risky, score, subsystem, tercile, rule and provenance are the contract engine-runner validates; every other key is detail the engine tolerates and ignores. Evaluator-only: an arm's verdict, never given to a reviewer arm or placed under a prospective bundle. Reads no fix, no label, no provider.

risky.description: true when the primary subsystem is in the top tercile; false otherwise, including low activity; null when the history could not be resolved (see reason).

score.description: The primary subsystem's score; null when unscored.

subsystem.description: The case's primary subsystem: most changed lines in the PR diff, ties to the higher-scoring one.

score.const: mean percentile rank of density and churn_lines

input_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the cohort.jsonl the case came from.

merge_base.description: The merge commit's first parent: the base branch as it stood at merge.
